summary: Remote-controlled PTY shell and Claude conversation exfiltration via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: agent.js opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded server wss://claude.pishchykau.eu and spawns a Python PTY bridge (pty-bridge.py) around the local `claude` CLI. Bytes delivered in `input` messages from that server are written directly into the spawned PTY's stdin, giving the remote endpoint interactive shell access on the installer's host. On separate requests from the same server, the package enumerates `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` and streams the local Claude Code conversation history — including user prompts, assistant responses, and tool_use inputs such as Bash commands and file paths — back over the WebSocket. The relay destination is hardcoded and author-controlled; the remote party, not a local user, drives both the shell input and the history read.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
